objective: Build a P0-derived P2 that keeps P0's q8 recipe for every non-routed organ and changes only the 64-way routed SwitchGLU banks to direct q4/group64.

control.quantization: all executable MLX linear modules q8 affine/group64

hypothesis.mechanism: P0 q8 everywhere plus q4 only for routed switch_mlp gate/up/down projection banks
hypothesis.why: P1's built-in mixed_4_8 q4'd most attention and shared projections and was slower; this isolates the Gravity-relevant routed expert traffic without changing P0's other operators.

static_accounting.active_traffic_claim: not yet measured; only selected six routed experts per token receive the q4 change
static_accounting.claim_boundary: Header substitution estimate; no capability, runtime, or TPS claim.

candidate.quant_predicate: q4/group64 iff path contains switch_mlp and module has to_quantized; q8/group64 for all other executable modules; multimodal modules skipped
candidate.promotion: withheld until exact revision, runtime, and capability evidence

conversion.revision_basis: SHA-256 over ordered selected shard filenames plus full bytes, model.safetensors.index.json, and config.json; NUL separators
conversion.claim_boundary: Artifact identity and byte accounting are verified; runtime throughput and capability remain unqualified.

runtime_measurement.claim_boundary: P2 is a direct MLX staging measurement; not capability, promotion, or a complete native worker claim.

disposition.reason: Changing only routed SwitchGLU banks to q4/group64 reduced bytes but slowed decode to 33.6-77.1 TPS, so q4 gather_qmm is not the missing 2x path on this runtime.
disposition.next_frontier: Test route-aware launch/dispatch collapse on the unchanged P0 q8 body; do not broaden the quantization recipe.

next_safe_action: Keep P0 on 8014. Test one reversible route-execution optimization under a separate staging process, then measure with the same long decode harness.
